task_completion.description: Create exterior perimeter walls with dimensions approximately 8m x 4m and add dimension lines.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a rectangular wall perimeter in the 2D plan view. Check for at least two dimension lines (numerical labels with arrows) indicating lengths near 800cm and 400cm (or 8m and 4m).

task_completion.description: Add at least two interior partition walls to create four distinct functional zones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for internal wall lines that divide the main rectangle into smaller rooms, specifically creating a separate enclosed area for a bathroom.

task_completion.description: Incorporate one entry door, one interior door, and at least three windows.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify door icons (arcs/swings) on the exterior and interior walls, and window icons (thin rectangles within walls) at three or more locations in the 2D or 3D view.

task_completion.description: Define and name the four rooms: Living Room, Kitchen, Bedroom, and Bathroom.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for text labels placed within the floor plan areas in the 2D view identifying 'Living Room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', and 'Bathroom'.

task_completion.description: Furnish every zone with appropriate items from the catalog.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check for furniture icons in the 2D plan or 3D models in the preview (e.g., a bed in the bedroom, toilet/shower in the bathroom, sofa in the living area, stove/table in the kitchen).

task_completion.description: Save the completed plan to the specific path ~/Documents/SweetHome3D/tiny_house_plan.sh3d.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for the 'Save' or 'Save As' dialog box with the file path typed in, or the application title bar showing 'tiny_house_plan.sh3d' in the Documents/SweetHome3D directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to design the house rather than just creating a file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the wall tool, furniture catalog, and room creation tools within the Sweet Home 3D application window.

integrity.description: The design is created from scratch on a blank canvas.
integrity.visual_evidence: Early screenshots should show an empty grid or a new project being opened, followed by the incremental drawing of walls.

integrity.description: Dimension lines are manually placed as requested.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent should be seen selecting the 'Create dimensions' tool and clicking points on the walls to generate the 8m and 4m labels.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create a new .sh3d file. The dimensions must be approximately 8m x 4m. The four required room names are 'Living Room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', and 'Bathroom'. The final file must be saved specifically to /home/ga/Documents/SweetHome3D/tiny_house_plan.sh3d. A score of 60/100 is required to pass.
